indicators.name: Common Web Attack Patterns in URL
indicators.pattern:
title: Common Web Attack Patterns in URL
id: e1c2a3b4-d5e6-4f7a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects common web attack patterns such as SQL injection, XSS, and path traversal in URL requests, as suggested for hunting in the EU Academy breach.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-24
references:
  - https://cryptobriefing.com/amazon-ai-agents-exploit-zero-day/
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection_sqli:
    c-uri|contains|all:
      - 'SELECT'
      - 'FROM'
  selection_xss:
    c-uri|contains:
      - '<script'
      - 'alert('
      - 'javascript:'
  selection_trav:
    c-uri|contains:
      - '../'
      - '..\'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects common web attack patterns such as SQL injection, XSS, and path traversal, as suggested for hunting in the EU Academy breach.

indicators.name: Anomalous Authentication Attempts with Common Attack Tools
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Authentication Attempts with Common Attack Tools
id: f2d3b4c5-e6f7-4a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: Detects failed authentication attempts where the User-Agent indicates the use of common attack tools like sqlmap or hydra. This aligns with hunting for anomalous login patterns as suggested in the EU Academy breach analysis.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-24
references:
  - https://cryptobriefing.com/amazon-ai-agents-exploit-zero-day/
tags:
  - attack.t1078
  - attack.t1595
level: high
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection_ua:
    c-useragent|contains:
      - 'sqlmap'
      - 'hydra'
      - 'nmap'
      - 'nikto'
  selection_fail:
    sc-status:
      - 401
      - 403
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects failed authentication attempts where the User-Agent indicates the use of common attack tools like sqlmap or hydra. This aligns with hunting for anomalous login patterns as suggested in the EU Academy breach analysis.

indicators.name: Anomalous High-Volume Data Egress
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous High-Volume Data Egress
id: a3b4c5d6-f7a8-4b9c-8d1e-2f3a4b5c6d7e
status: experimental
description: Detects network connections with an unusually large amount of data sent, potentially indicating data exfiltration as seen in the EU Academy breach. This rule should be tuned for the specific environment.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-24
references:
  - https://cryptobriefing.com/amazon-ai-agents-exploit-zero-day/
tags:
  - attack.t1530
level: low
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    sc-bytes|gt: 10000000
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate large file downloads or API responses.
indicators.description: Detects large or unusual data transfers from web application backend servers, which could indicate data exfiltration as seen in the EU Academy breach.
